rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a commercial advertisement.

example.english: This advertisement makes the new phone sound really great.
example.traditional: 呢個廣告講到部新手機好似好正咁。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 gong2 dou3 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 hou2 ci5 hou2 zing3 gam2

rows.note: Use 通告 for an official or public notice issued to inform people rather than sell something.

example.english: The management office posted an advertisement saying the water will be shut off tomorrow.
example.traditional: 管理處貼咗通告，話聽日會停水。
example.jyutping: gun2 lei5 cyu3 tip3 zo2 tung1 gou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 ting4 seoi2
